name: John R. Gibson
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists John Gibson as an author of “Large-scale regional topographic mapping using LiDAR survey data”.
The GeoCart programme and proceedings use “John Gibson” and “John R. Gibson” for the same regional topographic LiDAR contribution.
